y_failures: Says Libavius 'famously attacked the salve as "impostorous" and "superstitious"', citing Croll p.397. That page only says Libavius 'insults and rails against' the salve; the quoted words come from Goclenius p.103. It also says Goclenius 'attributed the secret to Paracelsus', but Saltzmann p.7 says Goclenius denies Paracelsus was the author.
reason: Every quotation in X appears on its cited page, and X answers the question with good primary sources. Y uses more sources, but it puts quoted words in Libavius's mouth that his cited page doesn't support and misstates Goclenius's position on who invented the salve.
